cls: Should we also verify the record values?
nit: An Array of numbers will produce more bytes than `kRecordSize`. We could use a Uint8Array instead: const record = new Uint8Array(kRecordSize); crypto.getRandomValues(record);

Maybe we should pre-emptively disable on all the sanitizers to avoid flakiness? ``` (defined(ADDRESS_SANITIZER) || defined(LEAK_SANITIZER) || \ defined(MEMORY_SANITIZER) || defined(THREAD_SANITIZER))…
